name: science-round
description: One auditable science-agent round driven by a domain pack: scout, independent hypothesis lenses, selection, batch registration, sandboxed runs, adversarial verification, and L3 review
whenToUse: Run one round in a locked science-agent workspace (any domain pack: predictive, scored, equation). Usually invoked by the science-campaign workflow; call it directly for a single round after `sagent round begin`. Returns evidence only; `sagent round close <round_id>` decides, writes claims and the report, and ends the round.

phases.title: Scout
phases.detail: domain pack, data/metric/risk profile, prior state

phases.title: Select
phases.detail: code ranks value, calibration, novelty and diversity; batch registration

phases.title: Implement & Execute
phases.detail: one engineer per candidate; multi-seed packs screen on one seed, then confirm the promoted

phases.title: Verify
phases.detail: L0-L3 per run with suspicion reruns, then an L3 review when something looks off
